name: Kung Pao Chicken
description: A classic Sichuan dish featuring tender chicken, peanuts, and vegetables in a spicy, savory sauce.
chineseDescription: 经典川菜，鸡肉嫩滑，配以花生和蔬菜，酱汁香辣可口。
steps: 【Prepare Chicken】Cut chicken breast into uniform 1-inch (2.5cm) cubes for even cooking. Place in a bowl.
【Marinate】Add 1 tbsp soy sauce and 1 tsp cornstarch to the chicken. Mix well with hands or chopsticks until chicken is evenly coated. Let marinate for 15 minutes at room temperature.
【Make Sauce】In a small bowl, combine remaining 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp rice vinegar, 1 tbsp sugar, and 2 tbsp water. Stir until sugar dissolves completely. Set aside.
【Prep Aromatics】Mince 3 cloves garlic and 1 inch ginger finely. Cut 2 bell peppers into 1-inch pieces. Chop 2 green onions into 1-inch lengths.
【Heat Wok】Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over HIGH heat (about 400°F/200°C). The oil is ready when it shimmers.
【Cook Chicken】Add marinated chicken in a single layer. Let sear for 30 seconds without moving, then stir-fry for 3-4 minutes until golden brown and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
【Toast Chilies】In the same hot wok, add 4 dried red chilies. Stir constantly for 30 seconds until fragrant. Be careful not to burn them.
【Bloom Aromatics】Add minced garlic and ginger to the wok. Stir-fry rapidly for 30 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
【Cook Vegetables】Add bell pepper pieces. Stir-fry on high heat for 2 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
【Combine】Return the cooked chicken to the wok. Pour the sauce mixture over everything. Toss continuously for 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats all ingredients evenly.
【Add Peanuts】Add 1/2 cup roasted peanuts. Toss gently for 30 seconds to warm through and coat with sauce.
【Serve】Transfer to a serving plate. Garnish with chopped green onion tops. Serve immediately with steamed jasmine rice.
tips: Adjust the number of dried chilies based on your spice preference. Use Sichuan peppercorns for authentic numbing flavor.

name: Mapo Tofu
description: A famous Sichuan dish with silky tofu in a spicy, numbing sauce with ground pork.
chineseDescription: 著名川菜，豆腐嫩滑，配以麻辣酱汁和猪肉末。
steps: 【Prepare Tofu】Cut 400g soft tofu into 1-inch (2.5cm) cubes. Place on paper towels to drain excess moisture for 5 minutes. Handle gently as soft tofu breaks easily.
【Prep Ingredients】Mince 3 cloves garlic and 1 inch ginger finely. Chop 2 green onions. Mix 1 tsp cornstarch with 2 tsp cold water in a small bowl until smooth.
【Toast Peppercorns】Heat a dry wok over medium heat. Add 1 tbsp Sichuan peppercorns and toast for 30-60 seconds until fragrant. Remove and crush lightly. Set aside for garnish.
【Cook Pork】Heat 2 tbsp vegetable oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Add 200g ground pork, breaking it apart. Cook for 3-4 minutes until browned and no longer pink.
【Add Aromatics】Add minced garlic and ginger to the pork. Stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
【Add Doubanjiang】Add 2 tbsp doubanjiang (fermented bean paste). Stir-fry for 1 minute until the oil turns red. This gives the dish its signature color and flavor.
【Add Liquid】Pour in 1 cup chicken stock and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Bring to a boil.
【Add Tofu】Gently slide tofu cubes into the sauce. Do not stir vigorously or tofu will break. Use a spatula to gently push tofu to submerge in sauce.
【Simmer】Simmer for 5 minutes, occasionally spooning sauce over the tofu. This allows flavors to penetrate the tofu.
【Thicken】Make a well in the center and add cornstarch mixture. Gently fold to combine without breaking tofu. The sauce should coat the back of a spoon.
【Serve】Transfer to a serving bowl. Sprinkle with crushed Sichuan peppercorns and chopped green onions. Serve immediately with steamed rice.
tips: Handle tofu gently to keep cubes intact. Toast Sichuan peppercorns for maximum numbing effect.

name: Sweet and Sour Pork
description: Crispy pork pieces coated in a tangy sweet and sour sauce with colorful vegetables.
chineseDescription: 外酥里嫩的猪肉配以酸甜可口的酱汁和彩色蔬菜。
steps: 【Cut Pork】Cut 500g pork tenderloin into 2-inch long, 1/2-inch thick strips. Uniform size ensures even cooking.
【Make Batter】In a bowl, whisk 1 egg with 2 tbsp flour and 2 tbsp cornstarch. Add a pinch of salt. The batter should be thick enough to coat the pork.
【Coat Pork】Dredge pork strips in remaining 1/2 cup cornstarch, shaking off excess. Then dip into batter. The double coating creates extra crispiness.
【Heat Oil】Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C). Test by dropping a small piece of batter - it should sizzle and rise to the surface immediately.
【First Fry】Carefully add pork pieces in batches. Fry for 3-4 minutes until golden and cooked through. Do not overcrowd the pan. Remove and drain on paper towels.
【Second Fry】Increase oil temperature to 400°F (200°C). Fry pork again for 30-60 seconds until extra crispy. This double-fry technique ensures maximum crunch.
【Make Sauce】In a saucepan, combine 1/2 cup ketchup, 3 tbsp rice vinegar, 2 tbsp sugar, and 1 tbsp soy sauce. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
【Thicken Sauce】Add 1 tsp cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp water to the sauce. Stir until thickened and glossy. The sauce should coat the back of a spoon.
【Cook Vegetables】Add pineapple cubes and bell pepper to the sauce. Cook for 1-2 minutes until slightly softened but still crisp.
【Combine】Add the crispy pork to the sauce. Toss quickly to coat evenly. Serve immediately to maintain crispiness.
【Serve】Transfer to a serving plate. Serve hot with steamed rice.
tips: Double-fry the pork for extra crispiness. Add sauce just before serving to maintain crunch.

name: Yangzhou Fried Rice
description: A classic Chinese fried rice with shrimp, ham, and vegetables.
chineseDescription: 经典中式炒饭，配以虾仁、火腿和蔬菜。
steps: 【Prep Rice】Use cold, day-old rice for best results. Break up any clumps with your hands. Cold rice separates better during stir-frying.
【Prep Ingredients】Dice 50g Chinese ham into small cubes. Peel and devein 100g shrimp. Beat 2 eggs in a bowl with a pinch of salt.
【Scramble Eggs】Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Pour in beaten eggs. Scramble quickly until just set but still moist. Remove and set aside.
【Cook Shrimp】Add 1 tbsp oil to the wok. Add shrimp and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes until pink and cooked through. Remove and set aside.
【Stir-fry Rice】Add remaining 1 tbsp oil to the wok. Add the rice and stir-fry over high heat for 2-3 minutes. Use a spatula to break up any remaining clumps.
【Add Ham and Vegetables】Add diced ham, peas, and corn to the rice. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes until vegetables are heated through.
【Season】Add 2 tbsp soy sauce and toss to coat the rice evenly. The rice should have a light golden color.
【Combine All】Return the eggs and shrimp to the wok. Add chopped green onions. Toss everything together for 1 minute.
【Finish】Drizzle with 1 tbsp sesame oil. Give a final toss. Transfer to a serving plate and serve hot.
tips: Use day-old rice for best texture. High heat and quick stirring gives authentic wok hei flavor.

name: Pork Dumplings
description: Traditional Chinese dumplings with juicy pork filling.
chineseDescription: 传统中式饺子，馅料鲜美多汁。
steps: 【Make Dough】Mix 500g flour with 250ml warm water gradually. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and rest for 30 minutes.
【Prepare Cabbage】Mince 200g Napa cabbage finely. Sprinkle with 1/2 tsp salt and let sit for 10 minutes. Squeeze out excess moisture.
【Make Filling】Combine ground pork, squeezed cabbage, green onions, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and white pepper. Mix in one direction until sticky and well combined.
【Divide Dough】Roll the dough into a long log. Cut into 30 equal pieces. Cover unused pieces with a damp cloth to prevent drying.
【Wrap Dumplings】Roll each piece into a 3-inch circle. Place 1 tbsp filling in the center. Fold and pleat the edges to seal. Practice makes perfect!
【Boil Water】Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add 1 tsp salt.
【Cook Dumplings】Gently slide dumplings into boiling water. Stir gently to prevent sticking. Bring to a boil, then add 1/2 cup cold water. Repeat this process 3 times.
【Check Doneness】Dumplings are done when they float to the surface and the skin looks slightly translucent. The filling should reach 165°F (74°C).
【Serve】Remove with a slotted spoon. Serve immediately with dipping sauce of vinegar, soy sauce, and chili oil.
tips: Add cold water during boiling to ensure the filling cooks through without overcooking the wrapper.

name: Xiaolongbao
description: Delicate soup dumplings filled with pork and rich broth.
chineseDescription: 精致的汤包，内含猪肉和浓郁汤汁。
steps: 【Make Dough】Mix 300g flour with 150ml hot water. Knead until smooth. Cover and rest for 30 minutes. The hot water makes the dough more pliable.
【Prepare Filling】Combine ground pork, green onions, ginger, soy sauce, Shaoxing wine, sesame oil, and white pepper. Mix well in one direction.
【Add Aspic】Fold in 100g cubed pork skin aspic gently. The aspic will melt during steaming, creating the signature soup inside.
【Divide Dough】Roll dough into a log and cut into 20 equal pieces. Keep covered to prevent drying.
【Wrap】Roll each piece into a thin 4-inch circle. Place filling in center. Pleat edges while twisting top to seal. Leave a small opening at top.
【Steam】Place dumplings in a bamboo steamer lined with cabbage leaves. Steam over boiling water for 8-10 minutes.
【Serve】Serve immediately in the steamer. Be careful when biting - hot soup inside! Dip in ginger vinegar.
tips: The key is the aspic which creates soup inside. Eat carefully - bite a small hole first to release steam.

name: Peking Duck
description: An iconic Beijing dish featuring crispy duck skin and tender meat served with thin pancakes.
chineseDescription: 北京标志性菜肴，鸭皮酥脆，肉质鲜嫩，配以薄饼。
steps: 【Clean Duck】Remove giblets and excess fat from cavity. Rinse thoroughly inside and out. Pat completely dry with paper towels.
【Air Dry】Hang duck in a cool, ventilated place for 12-24 hours. This dries the skin for maximum crispiness.
【Prepare Glaze】Mix honey with 2 tbsp hot water and soy sauce. Brush evenly over duck skin.
【Season Inside】Rub five-spice powder inside the cavity. Seal openings with bamboo skewers.
【Roast】Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Place duck on a rack over a roasting pan with water. Roast for 1 hour, turning occasionally.
【Check Doneness】Skin should be deeply golden and crispy. Internal temperature at thickest part should reach 165°F (74°C).
【Rest】Let duck rest for 10 minutes before carving. This allows juices to redistribute.
【Carve】Using a sharp knife, slice skin into thin strips. Then slice meat. Serve skin and meat separately.
【Prepare Pancakes】Steam Mandarin pancakes until warm and pliable. Cut green onions into brushes.
【Serve】Spread hoisin sauce on pancake. Add duck skin, meat, cucumber, and green onion. Roll up and enjoy.
tips: Air-drying the duck is crucial for crispy skin. Use a fan to speed up the process if needed.

name: Char Siu
description: Sweet and savory Cantonese BBQ pork with a glossy red glaze.
chineseDescription: 广式烧腊，猪肉甜香，外皮红亮。
steps: 【Cut Pork】Cut 500g pork shoulder into long strips, about 2 inches thick. This ensures even cooking.
【Make Marinade】Combine hoisin sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, five-spice powder, Shaoxing wine, and a drop of red food coloring if using.
【Marinate】Coat pork thoroughly with marinade. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours, preferably overnight. Turn occasionally.
【Preheat Oven】Preheat oven to 425°F (220°C). Line a baking sheet with foil and place a rack on top.
【Roast First Side】Place pork on rack. Roast for 12-15 minutes until starting to caramelize.
【Turn and Baste】Turn pork over. Baste with remaining marinade. Roast another 10-12 minutes.
【Glaze】Brush with honey. Broil for 2-3 minutes until charred edges appear. Watch carefully to prevent burning.
【Rest】Remove from oven and let rest for 5 minutes. This allows juices to redistribute.
【Slice and Serve】Slice against the grain into thin pieces. Serve with steamed rice or in bao buns.
tips: For authentic charred edges, finish under the broiler. The pork should have a glossy, caramelized exterior.

name: Sichuan Hot Pot
description: A communal dining experience with a bubbling spicy broth for cooking various ingredients.
chineseDescription: 聚餐体验，沸腾的麻辣汤底煮各种食材。
steps: 【Prepare Broth】Empty hot pot soup base into a large pot. Add 1.5L water or chicken stock. Bring to a boil.
【Prep Ingredients】Slice all meats paper-thin for quick cooking. Cut vegetables into bite-sized pieces. Arrange on platters.
【Set Up Station】Place hot pot in center of table with portable burner. Keep broth at a steady simmer.
【Prepare Dipping Sauces】Set up a sauce station with sesame oil, garlic, chili oil, soy sauce, and vinegar. Let guests create their own blends.
【Cook Meat】Dip thinly sliced meat into broth for 10-15 seconds until just cooked. Do not overcook.
【Cook Seafood** Fish and shrimp need 1-2 minutes. Watch for color change to indicate doneness.
【Cook Vegetables** Add leafy greens last as they cook quickly. Heartier vegetables like lotus root need 3-4 minutes.
【Enjoy Noodles** Add glass noodles to broth at the end to soak up flavors. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
【Refill Broth** Keep extra hot water nearby to replenish evaporated broth. Adjust seasoning as needed.
tips: Cook ingredients in order: meat first, then seafood, then vegetables. Don't overcrowd the pot.

name: Century Egg Congee
description: Creamy rice porridge topped with century egg and shredded pork.
chineseDescription: 绵滑的白粥配以皮蛋和瘦肉。
steps: 【Wash Rice】Rinse 1 cup rice until water runs clear. This removes excess starch for cleaner flavor.
【Start Congee** Bring 8 cups water or stock to a boil. Add rice and stir to prevent sticking.
【Simmer** Reduce heat to low. Simmer uncovered for 45-60 minutes, stirring occasionally. The rice should break down completely.
【Cook Pork** Season shredded pork with a pinch of salt. Add to congee during last 15 minutes of cooking.
【Check Consistency】Congee should be thick and creamy. Add more water if too thick, or cook longer if too thin.
【Add Century Eggs】Add diced century eggs during last 5 minutes. Gently stir to distribute.
【Season】Add 1 tbsp soy sauce and white pepper to taste.
【Serve】Ladle into bowls. Top with julienned ginger and chopped green onions. Drizzle with sesame oil.
tips: Stir occasionally to prevent sticking. Frozen rice breaks down faster for quicker congee.

name: Braised Pork Belly
description: Tender, melt-in-your-mouth pork belly braised in soy sauce and sugar.
chineseDescription: 五花肉酥烂入味，色泽红亮。
steps: 【Cut Pork】Cut 600g pork belly into 1.5-inch cubes. Uniform size ensures even cooking.
【Blanch】Bring a pot of water to boil. Add pork and boil for 3 minutes. Remove, rinse, and drain. This removes impurities.
【Caramelize Sugar】Heat 2 tbsp oil in a wok over medium heat. Add 3 tbsp rock sugar. Stir until melted and amber colored.
【Sear Pork】Add pork cubes to caramelized sugar. Toss to coat evenly. The sugar gives the pork its signature red color.
【Add Aromatics】Add ginger slices, star anise, and cinnamon sticks. Stir-fry for 1 minute until fragrant.
【Add Liquid】Add Shaoxing wine, soy sauce, dark soy sauce, and water. Liquid should almost cover the pork.
【Simmer】Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low. Simmer covered for 1.5-2 hours until pork is fork-tender.
【Reduce Sauce】Remove lid for last 15 minutes. Increase heat to reduce sauce until thick and glossy.
【Serve】Transfer to a serving plate. Pour sauce over pork. Serve with steamed white rice.
tips: The key is patient slow-cooking. Rock sugar gives a beautiful sheen and subtle sweetness.

name: Scrambled Eggs with Tomatoes
description: A beloved Chinese home-style dish with fluffy eggs and sweet-tangy tomatoes.
chineseDescription: 家常菜，鸡蛋松软，番茄酸甜可口。
steps: 【Prep Tomatoes】Cut 3 tomatoes into wedges. Set aside.
【Beat Eggs】Beat 4 eggs with 1/2 tsp salt. Mix well until uniform.
【Cook Eggs】Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok over medium-high heat. Pour in eggs. When edges set, push toward center. Repeat until eggs are just set but still moist. Remove and set aside.
【Cook Tomatoes】Add a little more oil to wok. Add tomato wedges. Stir-fry for 2 minutes until softened and juices release.
【Season】Add 1 tbsp sugar and 1/2 tsp salt. Sugar balances the tomato acidity.
【Combine】Return eggs to wok. Gently fold together. Do not overcook or eggs become tough.
【Finish】Drizzle with sesame oil. Garnish with chopped green onions.
【Serve】Serve immediately with steamed rice. This is ultimate comfort food.
tips: Cook eggs until just set for fluffiest texture. Add sugar to balance tomato acidity.

name: Steamed Fish
description: Delicate steamed whole fish topped with ginger, scallions, and hot oil.
chineseDescription: 清蒸全鱼，配以姜丝、葱丝和热油。
steps: 【Clean Fish】Scale and gut fish. Score both sides diagonally 2-3 times. Rinse and pat dry thoroughly.
【Set Up Steamer】Bring water to a boil in a wok or steamer. Use a heat-proof plate that fits inside.
【Place Fish】Place fish on plate. Put some ginger inside cavity. The ginger removes fishy odors.
【Steam】Place plate in steamer. Cover and steam for 10-12 minutes per pound. Fish is done when flesh is opaque and flakes easily.
【Drain Liquid】Carefully remove plate. Drain accumulated liquid - this liquid can be fishy.
【Add Toppings】Top fish with remaining julienned ginger and green onions.
【Heat Oil】Heat vegetable oil until smoking hot. Carefully pour hot oil over ginger and green onions. This cooks them instantly and releases aroma.
【Add Soy Sauce】Pour 3 tbsp soy sauce around the fish (not directly on top). Drizzle with sesame oil.
【Serve】Garnish with cilantro. Serve immediately with steamed rice.
tips: Do not overcook. Fish should be just cooked through for maximum tenderness.
